brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Cell piece:0,0,0;half-s (south half) carries drawer:0#0,0#cut on its north cut face (key=n). The same cell participates in spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at junction q0,0|q0,1|q1,0, which is the north-east/south-east corner of that half-cell formed with the two neighboring full cells piece:0,1,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full. Drawer and spike originate from the same cell (0,0,0) and occupy the same corner; meshClash=clear with no overlap proves they touch but do not clash.

finish.summary: Triangular 3-cell base with 0,0 as half-s to host a cut-face drawer. Drawer on north cut of 0,0 and spike at the 0,0|0,1|1,0 junction share the same corner of the same cell and are adjacent (no mesh clash, no rule error).

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
